steps.text: 17 Years Ago
2:44 P.M. \ Clear
Central Ursus, Pine Valley Retreat exterior
Hfff—huff—
Hfff—
Huff—
Hff.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Ah, old friend, are you feeling better now?

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: No, no, you lie down, I'm just here to see you, I'll be leaving soon after. A burdenbeast's work is never done, and the one who saddled me was myself, to boot.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: What? No, of course. To you, I'm still the same young lad you know, not the Minister of Finance.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: What's the point in fiddling with ranks? We're all here giving our strength to Ursus's vast land, striving for the truly honorable future Our Majesty envisions.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: We're all His Majesty's people. The few who've forgotten it, still living in the violent past, will sooner or later become orphans of archaic convention.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Sorry, it seems government business has built up some steam in me.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Don't worry, I can see how my colleagues and fellow strivers are strong in spirit, and I can see how the rot in the rotten eats away at themselves. We will be victorious.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Those loudmouth nobles in the Army... they and those woodworms will very soon be dust at His Majesty's feet, and we will sweep them out of His way.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: —The State Council is changing.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: We'll take everything Ursus, everything of His Majesty's back from those unthinking, undoing aristocrats' hands.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: We'll tear the olden days to shreds. Savage them. Profane them. We must open a new way for Ursus, old friend—I will do it. We all will do it. Even if it takes our whole lives.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Ursus needs change.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Today?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: The original plan was next week... but today's the best chance.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I just heard the head caretaker say. The Minister of Finance's arrival is clearly intended to rattle that spineless coward. Though the Minister was unwilling to meet him, he was at least willing to move himself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He's frightened. And fear will make him show openings.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: His guards might not have been able to arrange for this sudden meeting in time, but he had no choice except show himself before us, as hastily as possible...

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: With another Ursus VIP visiting, opting to assassinate the Grand Duke is an extremely risky idea, but this place has never been empty of major players, and I can count the number of times the Grand Duke left his area alone on one hand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're still not certain enough.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I'm still not certain enough.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: But I trust you are.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I've wanted to believe, even, that you could always do it.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Tell me, do you still have any misgivings?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I'll settle them for you, even if I—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Lillia.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: My greatest misgiving... is whether you'll live well, as I hope for you to.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter how you'll regard what I say next, I still must recognize: in Chernobog, all those youngest, richly idealistic, most ardent scientists... all gave their lives.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am not willing to see them die. Lillia, I regard you in the same way right now.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I can't do that, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After this is over, I'll make for Siracusa, then on to Victoria.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you come with me... and don't continue with your plans in Chernobog, then you don't have to die.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I can't bear traitors stamping footprints on my husband's dried blood, not for even one second.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're very selfish.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I am. So don't you forget my most selfish request of all...

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Look after my daughter, and if she's willing, teach her medicine.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: You can surely live on, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Old friend.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Winter this year is very cold, but I trust spring will be warm as it ever was.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: I still remember the day we first met was at the beginning of spring. Attending that speech so brimming with passion, you didn't cheer, nor did you bellow.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: We noticed each other when our eyes met, and of course others too.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: No one felt any pride in the successful invasion, those cheering and revering the former Emperor's glory, unable to even see the barren land they stood on, having allowed no one else to survive.

a.text: Witte, is spring coming?

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: I do not know, old friend. Perhaps.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Spring this year may come slightly early, but my Catastrophe Messenger tells me, following a fierce Catastrophe up north, it may be cooler after some days.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Perhaps we may even return to winter.

a.text: None of us like winter, do we?

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: I don't like it either, old mate.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: But you did warn me, perhaps I should give up the bottle... I shouldn't be weathering winter with drink. All it does is numb. Drunkenness might get me frostbitten.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: But winter won't last too long.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Just the fallout of a calamity.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: An eternal rest. The most secure method, completely effective, and not so fast-acting it gives us nowhere to run.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Have you fully prepared our retreat?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: From the first day we arrived, I'd already finished preparing everything.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Perhaps we won't have much time.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I understand that, but if we just do it like we practiced, we should have plenty of...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've taken this sanatorium as far too simple a place.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your plan doesn't need to change. Leave everything afterwards for me to handle.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: What did you find out?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr discovered traces of the enemy while hibernating. Have you heard of the Grand Duke having dealings with other powers of Ursus, or not?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: No, he's been content here all this time.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Mon3tr... is that that pet of yours? What did it see? Some Ursus folk legend?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I cannot realistically tell you the facts. That would only shrink our chances of survival to the minimum.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Mm... Ursus has many, many means...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Fear becomes a lure. Investigating this will only serve to affect your judgment. Trust me.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Alright. It's about time now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: See the blonde Feline carrying a bag—he's the Grand Duke's private doctor.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: What can a Grand Duke accomplish?

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Look at these fellows stuck in their old ways... Of course, the moment that half-blinded governor knelt in front of His Majesty, he ceased to be any more of a threat.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: He's very smart, choosing when it suited to save his own skin. Nothing like some people... putting up last stands for their own selfish gains, even squandering what little live power Ursus had left to deal with the aftermath of the rebellions.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: It grieves me so... Though I'm no military leader, whenever I see our motherland's production at a standstill, the economy in decline, I lament deep and deeper.

a.text: Did His Majesty pardon these opportunists? They'd put their own interest above His Majesty's and Ursus's with just one inch of slack, in one heartbeat.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Don't condemn His Majesty's benevolence. Compared to putting up with a few shrewd but provisionally loyal nobles, what we truly cannot bear is continuing our endless internal friction.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: We must think of ways to pull out the weeds and pests. We must sow the seeds. We must, when spring comes again, see the new buds.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: For this I've strived... please pardon my language; I very rarely say such things, but I swear upon His Majesty, I do feel pride in my own present status.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Old friend, be reassured. Those sacrificed cannot complete their undertaking. All those who survived will keep trying, and trying.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: His Majesty will bring a new future to Ursus. Even the most stubborn nobles, and those twisted deities, and those monsters planted in the darkest corners of our motherland, they all must fear—they all must fear our Emperor.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: My duty is simply to ensure this.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Halt.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Did the head caretaker not tell you? Grand Duke Vanya has requisitioned this place, and no one is to come near.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I'm the doctor on shift today. I'm the Grand Duke's medical consultant, by all rights. This is my work permit.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: You're new here?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Grand Duke Vanya's doctor on duty is his private doctor. It's an unwritten rule. Lucky you, you pretty much get a vacation today.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Seeing as it's your first time, I won't blame you. But wander around this corridor again, and your death will not be pretty.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Now, get out. Find somewhere to spend your vacation while you have it.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: It's me. Not much. The doctor on shift at the retreat. I'll get them out of here...

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: What...? The quack's vanished?

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: But it'd be dangerous to... erm... the Minister of Finance is here, I know...

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: You two, halt.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Yes, we're listening to you.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Can I ask if something's the matter?

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Listen. No matter what you find, it's because of the Grand Duke's same old problems. Don't make a fuss over nothing.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Be dependable. Take care of him properly. Get out quickly after the sun's down, and don't disturb his peace.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Treat him properly, and you'll be rewarded. Amply. Enough for... poor people like you to live happily for a long time.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Thank you kindly. We're honored to have this chance... Kal'tsit, where's your thanks?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ah... right. Thank you kindly, good sir.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Hmph, country people. Don't mess this up.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: We'll pay full attention.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Hold it.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: It's always been one person going in alone. We can't make an exception this time, or the Grand Duke will turn his rage on us.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Let this servant go in.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: —But, sir, I'm the doctor here—

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: We prepare the medicine the Grand Duke takes. You just stay here and wait, and if anything happens, go in then.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I don't understand—

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: I am saying to wait here for three hours, on standby.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: And then, you. You cannot be in there for more than ten minutes.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: If you take too long, no matter why, you will not leave alive.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Search, and then let this servant go in first.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As you command.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Grand Duke.

a.text: With his back to the light sits an old man—lies an old man. He does not move, his breathing tranquil, gazing into the far distance.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Is it the doctor?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, I am only a servant.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Alright... come, come closer.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As you command.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Are you Ursus?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Lower your head. Let me feel your face.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As you command.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Ah... Vulpo, or maybe Feline? An adorable race.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are... Are your eyes unsighted?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Yes. A problem from last month.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: I'm due to die. Suppose it today, suppose it tomorrow. So you've come in vain, child.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: They won't allow the doctor in—they're murdering me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Won't you protest? You are a Grand Duke.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Exactly why. I am powerless to resist Ursus. I have since accepted that.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: How is the weather today? I can feel the sunshine, turning warm now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Not a cloud in sight, Grand Duke.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Ah... not a cloud in sight. It's been long. Since the last day like this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you feel despair?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Despair...? Despair is but a passer-by of the start. Our endless lives are always suffused with an emotion. It neither induces despair, nor makes your life bottomless joy.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: We are all living in compromise. Some would call it apathy, and some would say, I am simply reaping what I sowed.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Yes. The weather is warming. That gust of wind just now failed to chill me to the bone.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Who sent you, young lady?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You've already surmised.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: And you are not astonished? Say, I thought a sum failure like myself would have been scapegoated in the limelight, forever looked down on by the young.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have never looked down on a single person, let alone you, a Grand Duke of Ursus.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Of course you wouldn't tell me honestly... as to be expected. Let me take a guess...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: The Minister of Finance? No, no-no-no... he and my affairs are entirely unrelated. He does not possess this kind of finesse to interfere in others' stations. If it were his idea... I would rather it his idea.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Well, then, was it some woodworm in the Army? Those old, timid, cowardly bastards... not them, not them either, they have simpler ways...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Let me guess, young one, who sent you here...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Are you still there, young one?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Was it His Majesty's idea? His Majesty wants an... arrogant fool like me to pay the price for his own stupid actions?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Oh, I knew that evening was not but a nightmare...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Do you know how it feels to be blind in both eyes? From that dark view I had long been used to, I felt some more warped thing, squirming... the otherly sensation of fear.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You mean the fear that cannot even be concealed by blindness.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: That was the Royal Guard's will, young one. That evening, the Emperor's Blade was only a step away from my throat.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: What? A paring knife? Let me do it.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: The journey will be very tight, but if I don't even have the time to peel an apple for my friend, I can't help but be disillusioned.

a.text: How could I let the Minister of Finance do some odd chore like this.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Are you mocking me?

a.text: Perhaps a Minister of Finance should not hold a knife. You should focus on something else.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Don't joke with me, old friend. I'm just peeling an apple. Don't tell me you're about to rave superstitious at me?

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Look, how fresh the fruits here at the retreat are. These'll be good for your health, too.

a.text: No, Witte, my friend, give the knife to me. Perhaps I'm due for some exercise, so as not to rust myself away.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: You're too feeble. You might cut your own hand open.

a.text: Surely, you don't feel a staff officer of the Army of Ursus would lack the strength for even a paring knife?

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: No, I don't think that.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Ah, fine, old friend, have the knife. Be very careful.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: What are you—Doctor!—What are you doing?!

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Why treat yourself like this—Cutting your own finger—Doctor!

a.text: Gasp—Witte! Don't worry, this doesn't hurt like you imagine... my year-round pains have already accustomed me... don't hurry off, now, listen to me first.
Look, Witte, on my right hand, the racket of artillery gunfire shook off some fingers... Kazimierz people lopped my right thumb off, and a Higashi assassin made off with half my pointer.
I've always felt my right hand was undersold, Witte, taken simply for a knife hand, it fell to such treatment.
Now, I have cut off my left-hand pointer. Here, both my hands are no longer sound. Very fair.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: What is all this for...!

a.text: Tell me, Witte, from Ursus's wars, these glorious scars I once regarded as an honor all my life, do they truly have any glory to speak of?

No, I don't need you to answer me. It's a trifling thing, but see, my fresh wound, blood dripping, this was done by my own will. It awakens me from my grave affliction, allows me to converse with you again.
Witte, you will return to Deity Grypherburg, correct? You will sooner or later return, back to that grand city.
Take a piece of my form, my constitution with you. My body was scattered about in campaigns, subjected to ruin, but only this piece of flesh was separated by my own will.
I have no children, but this pointer finger—jeer at my foolishness, go on—this pointer finger is the only flesh I have birthed.
Take it to Deity Grypherburg, bury it in your garden, or in a flower pot by the street. Let me live in the earth of Deity Grypherburg.
Oh, let my flesh become one with Ursus... take me to Deity Grypherburg, to the heart of what all our generations have defended, to the heart of Ursus!
—Witte!

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: What's with all the people running around today... ugh, a flock of idiots who don't know the rules.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Stay here and don't move. I'm taking a look.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Alright, sir.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: (I don't know what Kal'tsit's doing in there...)

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: (Ugh. We don't have much time.)

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Hey, you, back to Room 116.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: What? But my helper is still in—

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: A servant is enough either way, here. No need for a doctor.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: This is the Minister of Finance's request. If you upset a minister, we'll never survive it.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Now leave! You want to see the gallows?!

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Yes, yes, sorry, I'm going now, right now...

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: (Kal'tsit...! Quick!)

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Young one, come, sit here. What's your name?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: That is neither a nom de guerre, nor a nom de plume, correct?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: I can hear... from the manner in which you introduce yourself, I can hear, you love this name, don't you, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hard to say.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We don't have long, Grand Duke. In a short moment, your guards will come charging in here.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Oh... it seems I must make space for the assassin after my own life...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Hmm. My communicator should be right by my side...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Here it is.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Ha. What a prudent murderer. Just when did you pilfer it?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Please give it to me.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Thank you for your trust, young one. You make such ease of it... no matter who sent you, I trust you will become one vastly capable.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Sir, this is a servant of the retreat... who hails from my homeland. I wish to chat with her further. Do not disturb us, until I give the order.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Trespassers are in violation of military order. Do you understand?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Where is your homeland?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Right on the other side of Pine Valley.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Are you so willing to trust me because you have all your means well prepared? Even if they came charging in, you could still escape unscathed, couldn't you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will not answer that.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Or you really aren't from the Royal Guard. You are neither twisted nor terrible. Yes, how could the Royal Guard leave their work to others?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: They are Ursus's most selfless monitors. Only those capable of being weighed on the scales, will the Royal Guard look at with value.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Alright. I've lost, young one. I cannot guess at all at your oh-so-mysterious past.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Why have you come?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: My duty lies here.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Kal'tsit, will I pass away painfully?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You won't. The drug will slowly erode your nervous system. You'll fall asleep as though entering a coma, and never wake up.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: To an old soul plagued by illness, this may even be considered a favor.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: I thank you.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: I've been meaning to ask, are you a doctor? A scientist?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Do you have a shining pair of eyes? Do the odors of medicine cling to your fingers?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Do—

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: —Hold on, hold on. Did you come... come for that affair in Chernobog?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Kal'tsit... Kal'tsit... the director who died in the inferno that day, was that the name?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you truly remember every sacrifice, then perhaps I'm unable to escape the all-seeing eye of Ursus.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Ah... it's you, you're the very Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: How strange... that you hid from the Secret Police. What's more, and stole into this place without even changing your name...?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: How did you do it?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There are always ways, Grand Duke.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Some want me dead, and some do not. I thought you a scientist, one that should not be so... easily fooled.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Ah... or could it be, some have paid you off? Some have exploited your vengeful rage, so as to have me killed?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I believe I have no comment, Your Grace.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is time. I will inject the drug.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Ah, you have signed my death warrant. Very good. This may be leagues simpler than such torture...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's done, Your Grace.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: How much time do I have left?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Fifteen minutes, Your Grace.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Tell me, young one, is the scenery before me very beautiful?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All the land is budding, and the sunshine will feed it, filling it with hope.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Is it beautiful?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's a magnificent scene, but this magnificence is trivially ordinary to Ursus.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Heh. Young ones always are good with words... How many of our people... could ever see this view?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: That's right... flowers, my flowers. I scattered seeds... have they sprouted? Have they begun to bud? These eyes of mine, so ruined, could not even persevere long enough to see them bloom...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So far, at least... you're out of luck.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It seems the Empire's winter was detrimental to the growth of these ornamental plants.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Ah... they cannot bloom here?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In this boundless winter, what did you plant?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: When I was young... I took part in a war against Kazimierz. Have you fought a war before, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: War is wild and chaotic. Ten-some minutes past the first sound of gunfire, formation and battlefield had lost all meaning.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: A few knights wounded my leg, and bludgeoned my head. I tossed my helmet aside, and as if for my life, I crawled... crawled until I reached a flower field.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: In there I blacked out, and was later saved by reinforcements. In my giddy daze, I remembered what those flowers were like.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Pine lilies.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Yes... after the war, I asked someone to bring back some seeds from the frontier. I hated their Kazimierz scientific name, and so called them by a completely new one.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: I like those flowers. My city regarded them as a symbol of the city itself. Ursus's soil... is more suited to raising them than Kazimierz's.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: My wife... cared for them, cared for them so well.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: But they... never broke through the soil.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Spring didn't come soon enough, Your Grace.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Ah... the earth of my beloved Ursus. Know it can nurture hopes of all kind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is irrigated, too, by the bodies of the poor and the Infected.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: I don't deny it has likely committed all manner of atrocity. Yet even so, the earth forgives all... ah, I feel tired...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That doesn't seem a very convincing excuse.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Excuse? No, young one... I never thought I'd earn any pardon, and I never wanted for one...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Only—Only in life's final moments, do I think... I was able to realize... the meaning... it was all...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Pine lilies...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: I want... to see her again...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Leave, now, young one.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: I feel... how warm, the sunlight, as if I... can, once... again, see...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: Hahh...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Perhaps you never had the means to pardon yourself in your final moments.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Ursine) May yet Ursus forget you, Grand Duke.

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: (Ursine) ...Ursus... my...

steps.name: Grand Duke Vanya
steps.text: ...motherland...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sir, the Grand Duke has fallen asleep.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: You don't need to tell me. We've had orders. We can only enter after half an hour.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Hah. Same home as the Grand Duke, hmph?

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: I've heard why you young women are all squeezing to work in this retreat. It's just to seek patronage from important nobles, isn't it?

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Are you satisfied now? What are you staring off for? Don't tell me you want me to shine your shoes?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, how could I dare... I'm very sorry! Sir, don't be angry, I'll be going right now...

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Gah, lowlife...

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Paring knives will very easily rust, and lead to infection. We'll pay close attention to his condition, rest assured.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Good, thank you.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: It seems the blood rushing to my friend's head has cost me a considerable amount of time...

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: After he leaves the infirmary, please tell him, he has set alight the blaze in our hearts, and please have him trust. Trust his friend Islam Witte.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: But for now, I must be on my way with my Messenger.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Safe travels.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: (Kal'tsit—!)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (We leave immediately.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (The Minister of Finance will have those bureaucrats' subordinates jumping at shadows. That's our best cover.)

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: (Is... is he dead?)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (The time to effect was shorter than I thought. He couldn't hold himself together much longer in the first place.)

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: (There are countless people who'll want to exploit his death. Maybe them fighting on all fronts will create an opening for us.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Let's go.)

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Kal'tsit—

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: For me... For us, you've put an end to it all, with your own hands.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It isn't over yet.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter in what form it takes... perhaps sooner or later, we'll confront this empire once again.
